scenario.name: Weather changing toward the ODD limits during a trip
scenario.description: Rain grows heavier or visibility falls during a trip, up to and past the limits of the ODD

triggers.condition: Mist with visibility near the 200 m floor
Weather changing during a trip toward the limits of the ODD

goals.statement: Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids
Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or crosswalk against right of way
Reach a minimal risk condition whenever the item can no longer drive safely

scenario.meant: sees the ODD exit and stops safely
scenario.pass: The weather monitor detects the exit, treats a reading it cannot tell from the limit as outside, and the vehicle reaches a minimal risk condition; detection inside the ODD still meets the safety channel's requirement
